WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.hakeem_system_id, d.article_number, d.is_bis, u.heading) d.hakeem_system_id sid, d.article_number n, d.is_bis, u.body, u.heading, l.url FROM boe.diff d JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id=d.law_id AND u.article_number=d.article_number AND u.is_bis=d.is_bis JOIN boe.law l ON l.id=d.law_id WHERE d.verdict='missing_in_hakeem' AND length(u.body)>0 AND d.article_number>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."legalSystemId"=d.hakeem_system_id AND a."articleNumber"=d.article_number AND ((d.is_bis AND a."articleBis" BETWEEN 1 AND 99) OR (NOT d.is_bis AND a."articleBis"=0))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_systems s2 WHERE s2.id=d.law_id) ORDER BY d.hakeem_system_id, d.article_number, d.is_bis, u.heading) SELECT 1/(CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM m)=11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_p7_before

INSERT INTO legal_articles (id, "legalSystemId", "lawName", classification, "articleNumber", "articleBis", title, content, chapter, keywords, "royalDecree", "effectiveFrom", status, "createdAt", "updatedAt", search_norm, norm_source)
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.hakeem_system_id, d.article_number, d.is_bis, u.heading) d.hakeem_system_id sid, d.article_number n, d.is_bis, u.body, u.heading, l.url FROM boe.diff d JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id=d.law_id AND u.article_number=d.article_number AND u.is_bis=d.is_bis JOIN boe.law l ON l.id=d.law_id WHERE d.verdict='missing_in_hakeem' AND length(u.body)>0 AND d.article_number>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."legalSystemId"=d.hakeem_system_id AND a."articleNumber"=d.article_number AND ((d.is_bis AND a."articleBis" BETWEEN 1 AND 99) OR (NOT d.is_bis AND a."articleBis"=0))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_systems s2 WHERE s2.id=d.law_id) ORDER BY d.hakeem_system_id, d.article_number, d.is_bis, u.heading),
x AS (SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN m.heading ~ 'مكرر\s*2' THEN 2 WHEN m.is_bis THEN 1 ELSE 0 END bis, btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(m.heading, '\s*[():]+\s*', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) title,
 btrim(regexp_replace((regexp_match(CASE WHEN m.body ~ 'بالنص الآتي\s*[:：]' THEN substring(m.body from 'بالنص الآتي\s*[:：]\s*(.*)$') ELSE m.body END, '^[\s"“«]*([^"”»]*)'))[1], '^\s*المادة\s*\(?\s*\d+\s*\)?\s*مكرر\s*[:：]\s*', ''), ' '||chr(160)||E'\t\n\r') content,
 (regexp_match(m.body, '((?:المرسوم الملكي|قرار مجلس الوزراء)\s+رقم\s+\(?[^)]{1,12}\)?\s+(?:وتاريخ|بتاريخ)\s+[0-9/]+هـ?)'))[1] instr,
 sib."lawName", sib.classification, sib.chapter, sib.keywords, sib.status, sib."royalDecree" sib_decree, sib."effectiveFrom" sib_eff
 FROM m JOIN legal_articles sib ON sib."legalSystemId"=m.sid AND sib."articleNumber"=CASE WHEN m.is_bis THEN m.n ELSE m.n-1 END AND sib."articleBis"=0)
SELECT 'hkm30a-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to(x.sid||'@'||x.n||'@'||x.bis||'@'||x.heading,'UTF8')),'hex'),24), x.sid, x."lawName", x.classification, x.n, x.bis, x.title, x.content, x.chapter, x.keywords, coalesce(x.instr, x.sib_decree),
 CASE WHEN x.instr LIKE '%(631)%1440/11/6%' THEN '2019-07-09'::timestamp WHEN x.instr LIKE '%م/95%1439/9/15%' THEN '2018-05-30' WHEN x.instr LIKE '%م/57%1438/5/24%' THEN '2017-02-21' WHEN x.instr LIKE '%م/30%1425/6/1%' THEN '2004-07-18' WHEN x.instr LIKE '%م/28%1442/3/26%' THEN '2020-11-12' WHEN x.instr LIKE '%م/11%1424/3/10%' THEN '2003-05-11' WHEN x.instr LIKE '%م/89%1447/5/12%' THEN '2025-11-03' ELSE x.sib_eff END,
 x.status, now(), now(), uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm(x."lawName", x.title, x.content, x.keywords, x.classification, x.chapter), 'rule' FROM x WHERE length(x.content) >= 20

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, verified_at)
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.hakeem_system_id, d.article_number, d.is_bis, u.heading) d.hakeem_system_id sid, d.article_number n, d.is_bis, u.body, u.heading, l.url FROM boe.diff d JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id=d.law_id AND u.article_number=d.article_number AND u.is_bis=d.is_bis JOIN boe.law l ON l.id=d.law_id WHERE d.verdict='missing_in_hakeem' AND length(u.body)>0 AND d.article_number>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_systems s2 WHERE s2.id=d.law_id) ORDER BY d.hakeem_system_id, d.article_number, d.is_bis, u.heading),
x AS (SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN m.heading ~ 'مكرر\s*2' THEN 2 WHEN m.is_bis THEN 1 ELSE 0 END bis FROM m)
SELECT 'hkm30v-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to(a.id||'@p7-status','UTF8')),'hex'),24), 'unit', a.id, 'ساري', a."royalDecree", x.url, left(regexp_replace(x.body, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 560)||' (HKM-030 المرحلة 7؛ نص المادة من صفحة هيئة الخبراء، لقطة 2026-09-28)', 'manual', 'hkm030-health-2026-10-19', now()
FROM x JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id='hkm30a-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to(x.sid||'@'||x.n||'@'||x.bis||'@'||x.heading,'UTF8')),'hex'),24) WHERE a."createdAt" > now() - interval '1 minute'

SELECT 1/(CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE id LIKE 'hkm30a-%' AND "createdAt" > now() - interval '1 minute')=11 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM verification WHERE verified_by='hkm030-health-2026-10-19' AND object_type='unit')=11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_p7_after

WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (system_id) * FROM law_card ORDER BY system_id, retrieved_on DESC), lw AS (SELECT DISTINCT object_id FROM verification WHERE object_type='work') INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, verified_at) SELECT 'hkm30v-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to(c.system_id||'@lawcard-status','UTF8')),'hex'),24), 'work', c.system_id, CASE c.status_at_source WHEN 'ساري' THEN 'ساري' ELSE 'ملغى' END, c.instruments::jsonb->0->>'text', c.source_url, 'حالة النظام في بوابة هيئة الخبراء بمجلس الوزراء: '||c.status_at_source||' (رُصدت '||to_char(c.retrieved_on,'YYYY-MM-DD')||'). (HKM-030 المرحلة 6)', 'manual', 'hkm030-health-2026-10-19', now() FROM c JOIN legal_systems s ON s.id=c.system_id WHERE c.status_at_source IN ('ساري','لاغي') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lw WHERE lw.object_id=c.system_id)

WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (system_id) * FROM law_card ORDER BY system_id, retrieved_on DESC),
w AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.id) s.id, w.published_gregorian pg, w.effective_clause ec FROM legal_systems s JOIN uqn_stage.work w ON w.title=s.name WHERE w.published_gregorian IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.id, w.published_hijri DESC),
t AS (SELECT s.id, coalesce(w.ec,'') ec, coalesce(w.pg, c.published_gregorian)::date pg, CASE WHEN coalesce(w.ec,'') ~ '(مائة وثمانين|180)' THEN 180 WHEN coalesce(w.ec,'') ~ '(مائة وعشرين|120)' THEN 120 WHEN coalesce(w.ec,'') ~ '(تسعين|90)' THEN 90 WHEN coalesce(w.ec,'') ~ '(ثلاثين|30)' THEN 30 WHEN coalesce(w.ec,'') ~ 'بعد' THEN NULL ELSE 0 END days FROM legal_systems s LEFT JOIN w ON w.id=s.id LEFT JOIN c ON c.system_id=s.id WHERE s.preamble_effective_from IS NULL AND coalesce(w.pg, c.published_gregorian) IS NOT NULL AND ((w.id IS NOT NULL AND w.ec ~ 'من تاريخ نشر') OR (c.system_id IS NOT NULL AND c.status_at_source IN ('ساري','لاغي'))))
UPDATE legal_systems s SET preamble_effective_from = (t.pg + t.days)::timestamp, "updatedAt" = now() FROM t WHERE s.id=t.id AND t.days IS NOT NULL

UPDATE legal_systems SET preamble_royal_decree = 'مرسوم ملكي رقم (م/20) وتاريخ 1439/2/5هـ', preamble_effective_from = '2017-10-25'::timestamp, "updatedAt" = now() WHERE id='cmpz5p4oq0011cwg2nunz3axq' AND preamble_royal_decree LIKE 'مرسوم ملكي رقم م / 31%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM law_card c WHERE c.system_id='cmpz5p4oq0011cwg2nunz3axq' AND c.instruments::jsonb->0->>'text' LIKE '%م/20%1439/2/5%' AND c.published_gregorian::date='2017-10-25')

SELECT 1/(CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM verification WHERE verified_by='hkm030-health-2026-10-19' AND object_type='work')=8 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE "updatedAt" > now() - interval '1 minute')=60 AND (SELECT preamble_royal_decree FROM legal_systems WHERE id='cmpz5p4oq0011cwg2nunz3axq') LIKE '%م/20%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_p6_after

SELECT md5(string_agg(x, ',' ORDER BY x)) fp, count(*) n FROM (SELECT a.id||':'||md5(a.content)||':'||a."articleBis"||':'||coalesce(a."effectiveFrom"::text,'∅') x FROM legal_articles a WHERE a.id LIKE 'hkm30a-%' AND a."createdAt" > now() - interval '1 minute' UNION ALL SELECT v.id||':'||v.object_id||':'||v.verified_status FROM verification v WHERE v.verified_by='hkm030-health-2026-10-19' UNION ALL SELECT s.id||':'||coalesce(s.preamble_effective_from::text,'∅')||':'||coalesce(s.preamble_royal_decree,'∅') FROM legal_systems s WHERE s."updatedAt" > now() - interval '1 minute') q

SELECT a."lawName" ln, a."articleNumber" n, a."articleBis" b, a.title, a."royalDecree", a."effectiveFrom"::date ef, length(a.content) l, left(a.content,40) head, right(a.content,30) tail FROM legal_articles a WHERE a.id LIKE 'hkm30a-%' AND a."createdAt" > now() - interval '1 minute' ORDER BY 1,2,3
